status: Accepted: preserve current native WAVE/AIFF rules and behaviour in fresh Bella implementation. Supersedes pending native-audio behaviour changes; no runtime/cutover.

authorization.statement: Ah ok. Lets just keep the same rules/behaviour for WAVE and AIFF that we already have.
authorization.context: User found the preceding detailed proposal too complicated. Preserve existing behaviour and focus implementation on simplicity/efficiency; stop further per-field native-audio requirements review.

agreedBellaRules.behaviour: Current OldScanner native WAVE/AIFF format recognition, metadata interpretation, useful results/labels and availability/failure behaviour are the reference. Carry over interpretation rules and useful cases into small fresh helpers, rather than patching/copying the whole old pipeline.
agreedBellaRules.formats: Keep currently supported native RIFF/WAVE, RF64/WAVE, FORM/AIFF and FORM/AIFC under current managed discovery/feature scope. No new format, codec, suffix/import feature or extra metadata columns.
agreedBellaRules.versionChecks: Do not add the pending FVER admission/version gate. Preserve current handling, including Avid AIFF-C without FVER. Earlier proposed stricter handling of present unknown/malformed FVER is not accepted.
agreedBellaRules.implementation: Fresh C++17/Qt6.5.3 Bella code with shared small format helpers, scoped resources, compact useful results and clear temporary lifetimes. Read/extract/release and skip sound samples; avoid unused payload copies only while preserving required interpretation, diagnostics/availability and useful outputs. No new framework or per-chunk/per-column class.
agreedBellaRules.integration: Previously approved OMF parser requirements remain separate and authoritative for embedded OMF. One physical row, independent contributions and physical inventory remain. Final source priorities, header-read triggers and scheduling are still deferred; do not import OldScanner scheduling/completeness heuristics by implication.
agreedBellaRules.planning: Close native WAVE/AIFF field-by-field planning. Preserve the research as evidence, not new requirements. Implement/verify behaviour equivalence under agreed Bella-wide output contracts and explicit already-approved differences; raise only a concrete conflict if one actually blocks implementation.
agreedBellaRules.verification: Compare useful results with OldScanner during implementation; measure scan time and peak memory then. No measured improvement or current runtime implementation/cutover is implied.

supersededProposals: Additional native-audio field-by-field redesign, new metadata decoding/features or new format expansion.
Treating the earlier selective-read proposal as permission to change useful native results or error/availability behaviour.

validation.runtimeDiffBoundary: Pre-existing planning README only; no scanner/parser/test/CMake changes.
validation.independentScopeCheck: Current-source reviewer agrees preservation includes present/absent non-gating FVER, no further native field planning and unchanged separate OMF/global priority scope.
